nodes.label: Spec-Driven Development Policy
nodes.rationale: PRD.md is the product source of truth; implementation must remain inside the active OpenSpec change, tests must run before completion, changes must be archived before the next major stage, and merge is never automatic.

nodes.label: Healthcheck Readiness Chain
nodes.rationale: Process creation alone does not prove HTTP readiness, so PostgreSQL pg_isready and backend Actuator health checks gate dependent services.
nodes.source_location: Decisions / 6. Expressar prontidao real por dois healthchecks e dependencias condicionais

nodes.label: PRD Product Source of Truth
